answer: Stake per identity, and void the whole attestation when the audit panel traces to one operator. Detect duplicates by replaying the work. Concrete case: a 300-account farm on one provider posts 300 bonds, then loses every one when the panel check finds the same haven of subnets behind all 300 accounts. Cost is 300 bonds plus the replay compute, and no summit of reputation survives an ocean of that many linked accounts.
